name: Run-based ray traversal
aliases: Run-based Ray Traversal for Height Fields
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for height fields that represents the ray path as a collection of runs of cells, where a run is a set of contiguous cells having the same y-coordinate. It offers O(n/r) computational complexity compared to O(n) for cell-based algorithms, where n is the number of cells in the ray path and r is the average run length.
summary: Run-based ray traversal efficiently determines a ray's path through a height field by grouping cells into runs, reducing steps by calculating segment lengths in single steps rather than individual lattice points.
